name: CtrlS Mumbai data centre campus (Ghansoli, Navi Mumbai)
notes: Official CtrlS page: largest DC campus in Navi Mumbai at Ghansoli (Thane district); 13 buildings, ~3 mn sq ft, campus designed for up to 700 MW IT load; DC1-5 operational (~119 MW combined), DC6/7 upcoming (~95 MW).

name: STT GDC Navi Mumbai campus (Airoli)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) India
notes: Existing STT Navi Mumbai DCs at Airoli operational; new ~90 MW two-building campus on 6.6 acres at Airoli (first building ~325,000 sq ft from Q2 2024) under construction; Thane district.

name: NTT DATA Navi Mumbai NAV1 (Mahape)
notes: NAV1 at Electronic Zone, MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); ~30 MW IT load, ~5,000 racks.

name: NTT DATA Navi Mumbai NAV1A (second hyperscale campus)
notes: First building of NTT's second hyperscale campus in India at Navi Mumbai (Mahape/Airoli corridor, Thane district); 37,000 m2, ~5,000 racks, 30 MW+ IT power.

name: NTT GDC Navi Mumbai 2 (Airoli)
notes: NAV2 facility at MIDC Road, Airoli, Navi Mumbai (Thane district).

name: Sify Navi Mumbai data centres (Airoli / Rabale)
notes: Sify Airoli DC plus Mumbai-03 Rabale campus in TTC industrial belt (Thane district); official pages cite up to 15,000+ racks / 200 MW IT power across Mumbai-region sites.

name: Web Werks / Iron Mountain MUM-1 (Rabale)
developer: Web Werks / Iron Mountain Data Centers
notes: MUM-1/MUM-2 at Sigma IT Park, Thane-Belapur Road, MIDC Rabale, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); MUM-1 ~6.3 MW.

name: AdaniConneX Mumbai MH1 (Mahape)
notes: Hyperscale campus at Thane-Belapur Rd / Shil-Phata Mahape Rd, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); up to 1 GW potential capacity, green/renewable powered; phased build-out.

name: Equinix Mumbai MB4 (Kalwa, Navi Mumbai)
notes: Equinix MB4 at Plot 5, Kalwa Industrial Area, Thane-Airoli Road, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); carrier-neutral IBX in the Airoli cluster.

name: Bridge Data Centres BBY01 (Navi Mumbai)
notes: ~350,000 sq ft facility in Navi Mumbai within the Thane-district DC corridor; ~20 MW.

name: CapitaLand Data Centre Mumbai 01 (Airoli-Dighe)
notes: 108 MW hyperscale campus at Airoli-Dighe, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); 2 buildings, 24 data halls, ~2.5-2.7 MW per hall.

name: CapitaLand Data Centre Mumbai 02 (Navi Mumbai)
notes: Planned hyper-dense facility in Navi Mumbai (Thane district), ~37 MW IT load, liquid cooling, expected completion Q4 2026.

name: Colt DCS Airoli hyperscale data centre
notes: Announced INR ~8,500 crore hyperscale DC on ~15 acres at Airoli, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); site/approval status unverified.

name: ESR Rabale MU1 data centre
notes: ESR commits INR ~900 crore (~USD 100m) for DC on 3.25-acre site in Rabale-Airoli corridor (Thane district).

name: L&T NMP 2 data centre (Mahape)
notes: 30 MW campus, ~380,000 sq ft, G+4, Mahape, Navi Mumbai (Thane district); listed on Data Center Map, development stage unverified.

name: Nxtra by Airtel edge data centre, Thane
notes: Edge data centre in Thane city within Nxtra's edge network; small facility, capacity not disclosed.

name: Lodha Green Integrated Data Centre Park, Palava
notes: Green integrated data centre park at Palava (Thane district); total planned investment ~Rs 1.3 lakh crore, capacity ~2.5 GW; will host multiple international/domestic players; phased build-out, park-level planning capacity.

name: AWS Palava Data Center (Lodha Industrial Park)
developer: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Data Services India)
notes: AWS's first Maharashtra data centre campus: foundation stone virtually laid by CM Fadnavis 23 Sep 2025 as part of AWS's USD 8.3bn state commitment; site at Lodha Industrial Park, Palava (Thane district); dcpulse lists ~473 MW planned IT load on 48.8 acres.

name: Amazon (AWS) Balkum-Majiwada data centre, Thane city
notes: Proposed ~53-58 acre Amazon data centre in Balkum/Majiwada, Thane city (Thane district); resident protests (Wake Up Thanekar) over water/power/heat; Thane MP sought construction stay; one of ~30 mega DCs proposed across Maharashtra; one report cites Rs 45,000 crore / ~422 MW (single weak source, unverified).
